why: VATUSA/OIS#791. TGUI gate options come from two sources: the nav data's STARs for the airport (Flow.stars) and each live flight's arrival_gate (FlowFlight.gate). The web groups both with summaryGateName. backend/src/feed/flow.rs's tests check the backend half (stars_for and arrival_gate emit these exact strings); web/src/pages/airport-gates.test.ts checks the web half (both strings land in the same column). A change on either side that breaks the agreement turns one of them red.
